title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Trace copied history through received, durable and replayed progress. Choose read routing from freshness and failure promises, including read-your-write needs, stale reads and log retention.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns native standby controls and measurements.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns quorum-based agreement within one replicated partition; this article owns copied-history progress and read routing.

title: Failover and fencing
brief: Distinguish suspected failure from authority to write. Fence a former writer, choose a promotion point with an explicit loss boundary, reconcile divergence and rejoin safely.

neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns replicated membership and planned data movement, not primary/standby promotion.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns native physical promotion and return.

title: Inside PostgreSQL
brief: Trace one connection and request through PostgreSQL processes, shared buffers, heap tuples and indexes. Explain tuple visibility, HOT updates and their physical limits so native plans and maintenance have a concrete physical setting.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns retained horizons and transaction-age maintenance.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns durability controls and crash drills.

title: PostgreSQL logical replication and change feeds
brief: Configure a publication and subscriber with deliberate replica identity. Treat the stream as selective row changes, accounting for schema, sequences, lag, retained log and cutover responsibilities.

neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns durable application intentions and delivery semantics.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-upgrades: Owns full migration acceptance and write handover.
